Hi Susan — thanks for sending the signed W-9. Looping in Ben (sales) and Monica (procurement) to confirm next steps.

Short answers up front:
- We need to validate the EIN liveness for vendor banking and tax purposes before we move the PO from "staged" to "issued."
- Acceptable evidence: notarized bank letter OR one short live video verification where the vendor representative shows a government ID and a company bank statement/bank letter.
- If you prefer the video option, we record only a short verification note (consent must be documented). Redwood does not store the video long-term; we retain a brief verification log and the uploaded bank letter.

Proposed process (15 min):
1) Vendor sends signed W-9 (received).
2) Schedule a 10–15 min video check: vendor rep holds photo ID + recent bank letter on camera.
3) Vendor uploads bank letter to the secure Drive link or shares via DocuSign/Procurement portal.
4) Procurement stages the PO; final issuance after verification OK.

Can you do a video slot tomorrow (Mar 11) or Friday (Mar 12)? If so, please confirm attendee name and which ID they will present. Monica — can you confirm the PO staging rules (how long we can hold a provisional PO)? Ben — FYI for billing and contract flow.

I attached our standard PO template and a short consent text we ask vendors to read at the start of the call.

Attachments: PO_template_redwood_v1.docx (DOCX), video_verification_consent.txt (TXT)
